titleEn: Minimum Difference Between Highest and Lowest of K Scores
title: 学生分数的最小差值
summary: 从分数数组选择 k 个学生，最小化最高分与最低分之差。
insight: 排序后，任一最优集合可替换为覆盖其最小最大值之间的连续 k 项而不增大差值，枚举长度 k 窗口即可。
pitfalls: 选择的是任意下标但排序不影响值差

solutions.title: 排序长度 K 窗口
solutions.idea: 枚举排序后每组连续 k 个分数。
steps: right 从 k-1 到 n-1，更新 nums[right]-nums[right-k+1]，返回

code.java: class Solution { public int minimumDifference(int[] nums,int k){Arrays.sort(nums);int answer=Integer.MAX_VALUE;for(int right=k-1;right<nums.length;right++)answer=Math.min(answer,nums[right]-nums[right-k+1]);return answer;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun minimumDifference(nums:IntArray,k:Int):Int{nums.sort();var answer=Int.MAX_VALUE;for(right in k-1 until nums.size)answer=minOf(answer,nums[right]-nums[right-k+1]);return answer} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public: int minimumDifference(vector<int>& nums,int k){sort(nums.begin(),nums.end());int answer=INT_MAX;for(int right=k-1;right<(int)nums.size();++right)answer=min(answer,nums[right]-nums[right-k+1]);return answer;} };
